notes: Reworks the meters UI into a scalable object-first structure intended to map cleanly to the future Klyuchi app: one row per property/account, shortened address, search and month-status filters, and a separate property dialog containing that account's meters. Draft new readings and per-meter send selections are kept separately from portal state inside the running session. Meter submission to /meter/value remains disabled. Account switching continues to use the same proven /account/set flow as stable Domlight.
